name: GlucoTrack
label: Selected work
subtitle: CGM platform
cardDescription: CGM platform for device pairing, glucose monitoring, alerts, reporting, and patient account management.
heroDescription: A development-stage Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) platform designed to connect patients with supported glucose-monitoring devices and provide a complete digital workflow for device pairing, glucose monitoring, alerts, reporting, and patient account management.
overview: GlucoTrack is a development-stage Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) platform designed to connect patients with supported glucose-monitoring devices and provide a complete digital workflow for device pairing, glucose monitoring, alerts, reporting, and patient account management. The platform consists of a cross-platform mobile application, a web API, a SQL Server database, and a Bluetooth Low Energy device communication layer. It also includes a Windows-based BLE simulator used for development and hardware integration testing. The application supports the complete patient onboarding journey, including registration, login, profile setup, glucose-unit preferences, CGM device selection, Bluetooth permission handling, sensor scanning, device verification, and backend device registration. A key part of the project is the BLE integration workflow, where the mobile application scans for supported CGM devices, establishes a GATT connection, discovers the required services and characteristics, and verifies device information such as firmware version, serial number, battery voltage, temperature, and measurement status before registering the device with the backend. The patient dashboard provides a centralized interface for viewing glucose information, trends, history, reports, alerts, sensor status, and profile information. It also includes quick actions for logging meal, insulin, and activity events, as well as report export and sharing functionality. The backend provides secure REST APIs for authentication, patient profiles, device registration, sensor sessions, glucose measurements, glucose history and summaries, alerts, and database health monitoring. Authentication is handled using JWT access tokens with rotating refresh tokens, while user-specific data is securely scoped to the authenticated account.
challenge: Patients needed a complete digital workflow to connect with supported glucose-monitoring devices, complete onboarding, pair and verify a CGM sensor over Bluetooth, register the device securely, and monitor glucose activity through trends, history, alerts, and reports in one place.
solution: Built an end-to-end CGM platform covering patient onboarding, BLE device discovery and verification, backend device and sensor registration, secure account APIs, and a clinical dashboard for glucose monitoring, alerts, reporting, and profile management, with a BLE simulator for development and integration testing.

features.title: Cross-platform CGM patient app
features.description: Cross-platform CGM patient mobile application for the full monitoring workflow.

features.title: Secure registration and recovery
features.description: Secure registration, login, and password recovery for patient accounts.

features.title: Patient profile management
features.description: Patient profile and glucose-unit management as part of onboarding.

features.title: BLE device discovery and pairing
features.description: Bluetooth Low Energy device discovery and pairing with supported CGM sensors.

features.title: Device verification
features.description: CGM firmware, serial number, battery, temperature, and device-state verification before registration.

features.title: Device and sensor registration
features.description: Backend device and sensor registration tied to the authenticated patient account.

features.title: Glucose APIs and history
features.description: Glucose measurement APIs and history support for clinical monitoring flows.

features.title: Trend and summary dashboards
features.description: Glucose trend and summary dashboards for reviewing patient activity.

features.title: Critical glucose alerts
features.description: Critical low and high glucose alert handling.

features.title: PDF report sharing
features.description: PDF report generation and sharing functionality.

features.title: Event tracking
features.description: Meal, insulin, and activity event tracking from the dashboard.

features.title: Secure authentication
features.description: JWT authentication with refresh-token rotation and account-scoped data access.

features.title: Clinical data storage
features.description: SQL Server-based patient, device, sensor, glucose, and alert storage.

features.title: BLE hardware simulator
features.description: BLE hardware simulator for development and integration testing.

outcome: The project demonstrates a strong foundation for an end-to-end CGM ecosystem, combining secure patient management, real BLE device discovery and verification, backend APIs, SQL persistence, device registration, and a polished clinical monitoring interface. The remaining development work is mainly focused on completing the live glucose-data pipeline from physical sensor measurements through backend synchronization to real-time dashboard visualization.
